Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the sea hawk as the official raptor of the state of Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating an official state raptor; and addinga new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The sea hawk, commonly known as the osprey, is hereby designated asthe official raptor of the state of Washington.
